verdict.rationale: CIPO publishes downloadable bulk data through IP Horizons and its IP databases page. That gives bulk read and export across many trademark and patent records, but the evidence consists of page titles only. There is nothing on bulk write actions such as batch filings, renewals, maintenance-fee payments or amendments across many items. Missing for 10: bulk write and transactional operations (batch renew, pay or amend), any API or automation interface for batch actions, detail on bulk data formats and scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.
